reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: Code reading verified: from_execution_verified (L309) does skip KZG verification for EL-sourced columns, and cached columns bypass gossip KZG check (L486-500). However, this is BY DESIGN per the trust model. BUG_BOUNTY_SCOPE.json explicitly states Engine API is SEMI_TRUSTED with 'Some data from EL may be used without full verification by CL' and 'Compromised EL can affect CL behavior.' The comment at L228 and L487-490 acknowledges this design choice. The 01e invariant (from 01e_PARTIAL_W2B3_1771748669.json L1042-1057) requires KZG equivalence, but the trust model explicitly allows semi-trusted EL optimization. This is a trust boundary differentiation by design - local EL API is authenticated via JWT and treated differently than untrusted P2P peers. Attack requires compromising the local EL (co-located, JWT-authenticated), which is out of scope per conditional_scope rules for compromised local components. Not a vulnerability in the threat model for this contest.
reviewed_items.spec_reference: 01e_PARTIAL_W2B3_1771748669.json property PROP-6a4369e9-inv-041: 'Any optimized KZG verification path must produce same accept/reject as unoptimized batch verify.' Trust model: Engine API SEMI_TRUSTED, local EL optimization permitted.
